QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_38

question.text: FIRR (Financial Internal Rate of Return) is a return measure based on:

answer.text: The time value of money over cash flows

explanation.text: The Logic: IRR / FIRR is based on the timing and time value of cash flows. The workbook's sample question on this concept keys FIRR to the time value of money. The Trap: Options A, B and D all ignore the time value of money and rely on accounting / margin / book value concepts. Note: The time-value-of-money basis for FIRR is set out in the fund performance chapter of the workbook.
